{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for TREATMENT arm
treatment_arm = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded (responded == 1)
num_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_arm)
fraction_responded = num_responded / total_treatment

print(f'Number of patients in TREATMENT arm: {total_treatment}')
print(f'Number who responded: {num_responded}')
print(f'Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded}')

# Confirm the 'responded' column is binary
print('\n--- Value counts of responded: ---')
print(treatment_arm['responded'].value_counts())"}
